target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Those who have never used a spreadsheet before

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of spreadsheets (rows, columns, simple math)

system_requirements.hardware: PC or Mac with at least 4GB RAM

overview.positioning: Elevate your data skills from basic entry to advanced analysis and dashboarding.
overview.short_description: Master advanced formulas, Power Query, Power Pivot, and dashboard creation in Microsoft Excel.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Write complex formulas including VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, and SUMIFS
Clean and transform data automatically using Power Query
Analyze massive datasets using Power Pivot and Data Models

why_now.industry_shift: Data-driven decision making is now expected at all levels of business.
why_now.ai_impact: While AI can help, core understanding of data structures in Excel remains essential.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for professionals who can quickly analyze and visualize data.
why_now.career_opportunity: Crucial skill for analysts, managers, and finance professionals.

learning_outcomes: MASTER: Advanced Excel formulas and logical functions
AUTOMATE: Data cleaning processes with Power Query
MODEL: Relational data using Power Pivot
VISUALIZE: Business metrics through interactive dashboards

stages.name: Import
stages.desc: Connecting to data sources with Power Query

stages.name: Clean
stages.desc: Transforming data types and handling errors

business_use_cases.business_problem: Manual monthly reporting takes too long
business_use_cases.approach: Automate data fetch with Power Query and report with Pivot Tables

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Understanding data context and business logic
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Checking formula results against known data

best_practices: Never hardcode values in formulas; use references
Use Excel Tables for dynamic ranges

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Lack of awareness of newer/better functions
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Use INDEX-MATCH or XLOOKUP for flexibility and performance

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to handle large datasets without crashing Excel
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of automated reports and dashboards

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive raw data -> Clean -> Build Report -> Handover

final_deliverables: Comprehensive Interactive Business Dashboard powered by Power Query and Data Models

assessment.criteria: Formula accuracy, dashboard interactivity, and best practices

faq.question: Do I need to know VBA?
faq.answer: No, we focus on modern tools like Power Query which replace much of the need for VBA.

faq.question: Is this for Mac or PC?
faq.answer: The course is taught on PC. Mac users can follow along but Power Pivot is not available on Mac.

faq.question: Will we cover XLOOKUP?
faq.answer: Yes, we cover VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, and the modern XLOOKUP.
